intro.title: Polling Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom React hook called `usePolling` that automatically fetches data from an API at regular intervals. You'll learn how to use the `useEffect` and `useState` hooks to manage side effects and state in a functional component. The main technologies involved are React, TypeScript, and the `setInterval` function for timing. By the end, you'll have a reusable hook that can fetch and update data periodically, which is useful for live dashboards or real-time features.
intro.usecase: Polling hooks are essential for building real-time dashboards and monitoring systems that need to continuously fetch updated data. In production applications, you'll see this pattern in live stock trading platforms that refresh price quotes every few seconds, or in server monitoring dashboards that update CPU/memory metrics. It's also used in collaborative tools like project management apps to sync task status changes across users, and in e-commerce sites to check inventory availability during checkout. As a developer, you'll implement polling hooks whenever you need to display frequently changing data without the complexity of WebSockets.
